        <!-- Setup files and directories in <truth> for test verification -->
        <pre-existing-filesystem>
                <directory path="/home/user/backup-test">
                        <file name="file1.txt" content="Sample data file 1"/>

        <log-file path="/home/user/backup_sync.log">
                <entry>2023-11-05 10:00:00 - rsync executed successfully: 3 files synced</entry>

        </log-file>
